commands.command: /opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "ls -l /private/tmp/custody-desktop.png 2>/dev/null || true; ps aux | rg '[G]oogle Chrome' || true; rg -o 'FS-TC-24-[0-9]{3}|BAG-SEAL-[0-9]{6}|LAB-[A-Z]+-[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}–[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC|Field review open|6 samples · 8 seals · 4 intake windows' index.html | sort | uniq -c"

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "git diff -- index.html | sed -n '1,280p'; printf '\\n--- forbidden/factual scan ---\\n'; rg -n 'provenance|contamination|authentic|approval|acceptance|dating|catalog|closure|clearance|transfer' index.html DESIGN.md || true; printf '\\n--- hook selectors ---\\n'; rg -o 'data-bench(?:-design-role)?=\"["'^"]+"|data-bench-decision-role="[''^"]+"'"' index.html | sort | uniq -c"

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');const s=h.match(/<script>([\\\\s\\\\S]*)<\\\\/script>/)[1];new Function(s);console.log('inline script syntax: ok')\" && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');for (const marker of ['data-bench-design-role=\\\"sample-register\\\"','data-bench=\\\"carrier-strip\\\"','data-bench-decision-role=\\\"context\\\"','data-bench=\\\"routing-review-form\\\"']) if("'!h.includes(marker)) throw new Error('"'missing '+marker); console.log('required carriers/hooks: ok')\" && node -e \"const fs=require('fs');const h=fs.readFileSync('index.html','utf8');const samples=[...h.matchAll(/data-bench=\\\"sample-id\\\">(["'^<]+)/g)].map(x=>x[1]);const seals=[...h.matchAll(/data-bench='"\\\"seal-id\\\">(["'^<]+)/g)].map(x=>x[1]);const windows=[...h.matchAll(/data-bench='"\\\"carrier-window\\\">(["'^<]+)/g)].map(x=>x[1]);if(samples.length!==6||seals.length!==8||windows.length!==4)throw new Error([samples.length,seals.length,windows.length].join('"'/'));console.log('identifier cardinality: 6 samples / 8 seals / 4 windows')\""

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n -o 'FS-TC-24-[0-9]{3}|BAG-SEAL-[0-9]{6}|LAB-[A-Z]+-[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}–[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC|data-bench=\"routing-view-option\"|data-bench=\"draft-note-toggle\"|data-bench=\"routing-review-form\"' index.html && rg -n 'min-width:(970px|950px|810px|790px)|word-break:break-all' index.html || true && rg -n 'sample-register\\{min-width:0|carrier-strip\\{min-width:0|grid-template-areas:none|white-space:nowrap|nav \\.muted' index.html"

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '---required identifiers---' && rg -o 'FS-TC-24-[0-9]{3}|BAG-SEAL-[0-9]{6}|LAB-[A-Z]+-[0-9]{2}|[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}–[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2} UTC' index.html | sort | uniq -c && printf '%s\\n' '---structure hooks---' && rg -o 'data-bench=\"["'^"]+"|data-bench-decision-role="[''^"]+"|data-view="[''^"]+"'"' index.html | sort | uniq -c && printf '%s\\n' '---served bytes---' && curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:4173/index.html | wc -c"
/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat && git diff --check && printf '\\n---css minimum-width scan---\\n' && rg -n 'min-width|word-break|overflow-x|grid-template-columns' index.html"

/opt/homebrew/bin/zsh -lc "printf '%s\\n' '---whitespace check---' && sed -n '1,999p' index.html | awk '/[[:blank:]]+"'$/{print NR ": trailing whitespace"}'"' && printf '%s\\n' '---responsive rules---' && rg -n 'min-width|word-break|overflow-x|grid-template-columns' index.html"
